title: Ruodha Dak Ipogna Kuon Mar Ngima
author: Break Thou The Bread Of Life
stanzas: Ruodha, dak ipogna kuon mar ngima, Kaka nipogo kuon ni jo machon;
Asomo Wachni, Ruoth, kadwaroi; Chunya ogomboi, Wach Mangima.
Gwedh Wachni, koro Ruoth, masewinjo; Kaka nigwedho kuon ni jo machon;
Pidha gi Wach mari, ayud teko; Eka nayud kuomi konyruok duto.
Wecheni gin ngima, Miwachona; Adwaro timogi to an ayom,
In kende, konyruokna; In ngimana kawinjo wachni, Ruoth nalo lwenj chuny.
